entries.title: II Timothy 3:1
segments: But know this, that in the last days grievous times shall come.

entries.title: II Timothy 3:2
segments: For men shall be lovers of self, lovers of money, boastful, haughty, railers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,

entries.title: II Timothy 3:3
segments: without natural affection, implacable, slanderers, without self-control, fierce, no lovers of good,

entries.title: II Timothy 3:4
segments: traitors, headstrong, puffed up, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God;

entries.title: II Timothy 3:5
segments: holding a form of godliness, but having denied the power therefore. From these also turn away.

entries.title: II Timothy 3:6
segments: For of these are they that creep into houses, and take captive silly women laden with sins, led away by divers lusts,

entries.title: II Timothy 3:7
segments: ever learning, and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.

entries.title: II Timothy 3:8
segments: And even as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so do these also withstand the truth. Men corrupted in mind, reprobate concerning the faith.

entries.title: II Timothy 3:9
segments: But they shall proceed no further. For their folly shall be evident unto all men, as theirs also came to be.

entries.title: II Timothy 3:10
segments: But thou didst follow my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, longsuffering, love, patience,

entries.title: II Timothy 3:11
segments: persecutions, sufferings. What things befell me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra; what persecutions I endured. And out of them all the Lord delivered me.

entries.title: II Timothy 3:12
segments: Yea, and all that would live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution.

entries.title: II Timothy 3:13
segments: But evil men and impostors shall wax worse and worse, deceiving and being deceived.

entries.title: II Timothy 3:14
segments: But abide thou in the things which thou hast learned and hast been assured of, knowing of whom thou hast learned them.

entries.title: II Timothy 3:15
segments: And that from a babe thou hast known the sacred writings which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.

entries.title: II Timothy 3:16
segments: Every scripture inspired of God [is] also profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, for instruction which is in righteousness.

entries.title: II Timothy 3:17
segments: That the man of God may be complete, furnished completely unto every good work.
